title: Nodaro Site Capture
description: One web page, captured the way a phone (Pixel 7) shows it. The page script decides what is captured.

pageScript.title: Page script
pageScript.description: Source of an async function(context) that receives { page, response, request, Actor }, writes its screenshots with context.Actor.setValue and returns the dataset item. Nodaro builds it from site-capture-page.ts.

maxStills.title: Maximum stills
maxStills.description: Informational: the page script carries its own limit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Off by default (a direct connection). Residential proxy groups are refused.
